label: New run time after offloading
subgoals: Keep the non-accelerated fraction at its software time
Divide the kernel time by the accelerator speedup

label: Overall speedup and Amdahl's limit
subgoals: Divide the original time by the new time
Bound the speedup by one over the non-accelerated fraction
Rank candidate kernels by time fraction and arithmetic intensity

label: The break-even speedup
subgoals: Set the accelerated kernel time plus transfer equal to the software kernel time
Reject kernels whose transfer cost alone exceeds their software time
